title: Contact
description: Outreach target consumed by the Cold Mail Service. Mirrors the Contact dataclass in cold_mail_sender/models.py. See docs/architecture.md §4.3.  ENRICHMENT GAP (architecture §4.4): JobRecord has no recruiter email/name, but recipient_email is REQUIRED here. In the MVP, recipient_email (and optional recipient_name) are USER-SUPPLIED in the /outreach UI step before drafting. All other fields are auto-mapped from the JobRecord, parsed resume, and TailoredResume.

recipient_email.description: Recruiter/hiring-manager email. USER-SUPPLIED in MVP (enrichment gap).

candidate_name.description: From the candidate profile / parsed resume

candidate_background.description: From the candidate profile / parsed resume
